items.context: Kya aap international roaming activate karna chahte hain?

items.context: Kya aap apne current number par roaming activate karna chahte hain?
items.text: haa theek hai
mera number pe international roaming activate kar do please
maine agle mahine ke liye national roaming ka plan lena hai
kya aap mujhe batayenge ki roaming charges kya honge
international roaming ke liye kaun se documents chahiye mujhe
mera phone number hai nine eight seven six five four three two one zero
main UK ja raha hu to kya mera phone waha bhi chalega
mera account number two three four five six seven eight nine zero one two

items.context: Kya aap mujhe batayenge ki aap kis desh me ja rahe hain?
items.text: haan ji mera sim London jaayega aur roaming chahiye
mera number par international roaming activate kar dijiye please

items.context: Aap Dubai ja rahe hain na, tabhi toh roaming chahiye?
items.text: main Dubai jaana hu aur roaming plan activate karna hai

items.context: Kya aap payment mode bata sakte hain?
items.text: mere account se paise kat kar roaming activate karo

items.context: Kya aapko apne current plan me national roaming add karni hai?
items.text: kya aap mujhe national roaming ka plan details bhej sakte hain
main agle hafte India se bahar ja raha hu to mera international roaming activate karwa dena
mera account number two three four five six seven eight nine zero one two hai aur mujhe turant roaming chahiye
mera phone mein sim inserted hai number eight seven six five four three two one zero nine eight aur roaming enable karna hai

items.context: Aap kis desh me international roaming activate karwana chahenge?
items.text: ji sir main apna international roaming activate karwana chahta hu Switzerland ke trip ke liye

items.context: Kya aap apne national roaming ki request confirm kar sakte hain?
items.text: bilkul sir mujhe apne Delhi number par national roaming activate karwana hai aap help karenge?

items.context: Kya aap apna phone number confirm kar sakte hain taaki main activate karu?
items.text: mera phone number nine eight seven six five four three two one zero hai aur mujhe turant roaming activate karna hai

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: roaming - wants to activate international or national roaming
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
